voices.name: Anirudh Singh - Encouraging and Clear
voices.description: Hindi Voice Designed for viral content, historical narratives, mysteries, and educational storytelling. A captivating storyteller’s voice with a perfect balance of clarity, rhythm, and emotion. Smooth pacing, cinematic intensity, and natural emphasis make every line sound professional and immersive. If you want your content to feel premium and unforgettable — this voice delivers.

voices.name: Harsh - Deep, Calm and Encouraging
voices.description: Harsh’s voice is a rare blend of clarity, warmth, and composure—perfectly suited for deep storytelling and narration across genres. Whether it’s mythological tales, thoughtful reflections, lifestyle podcasts, audiobooks, children stories or insightful explainers, his delivery captures attention with ease. His mature, expressive tone makes him ideal for audio platforms long-form storytelling platforms like Radio and Spotify, and knowledge-based mobile apps.

voices.name: Vedish - Deep, Calm and Encouraging
voices.description: Vedish – Fiction Audiobook Voice for Dialogues & Emotions - Veer brings a vivid and immersive touch to fictional storytelling, especially where dialogues play a central role. His voice is dynamic, expressive, and emotionally layered—making him a top pick for audiobook genres like romance, drama, thriller, and youth fiction. His versatility shines when narrating multi-character plots or high-energy scenes. Ideal for fiction audiobooks, story podcasts, or voice-first apps.

voices.name: Pind Punjabi - Energetic and Encouraging
voices.description: Young male energetic Punjabi voice with desi natural tone & clarity. Best fit for all your Punjabi projects such as, ads, reels, tiktok, narration, storytelling, audiobooks and conversational AI.

voices.name: Shivank - Encouraging and Confident
voices.description:
Shivank S delivers a deep, powerful, and energetic Hindi voice that instantly grabs attention—perfect for high-impact social media content.

His tone balances authority and youthfulness, making it ideal for storytelling, commentary, rants, hooks, and punchy reels. Whether you’re building voice-led content for social media. Shivank’s voice adds gravitas while keeping it fun and relatable.

voices.name: Dev - Sharp, Energetic and Encouraging
voices.description: A young, professional & energetic Indian hindi voice narrator. Best for Content Creation, storytelling, Hindi audiobooks, emotional advertisements, and conversational role.

voices.name: Aarush - Clear, Encouraging and Friendly
voices.description:
Aarush brings a youthful, expressive & effortlessly relatable tone, fine-tuned for social media storytelling. His delivery is packed with modulation, energy, and authenticity—making him an excellent fit for viral reels, bite-sized video explainers, roleplay content, and regional storytelling.

This voice is ideal for creators targeting short-form platforms.

voices.name: Setu - Calm, Clear and Encouraging
voices.description: A warm and clear Hindi male voice that is easy to listen. Perfect for storytelling, like folk tales, and casual travel stories. Friendly, natural, and expressive for any type of narration.

voices.name: Taksh - Deep, Encouraging and Clear
voices.description:
A bold, articulate voice that bridges the depth of documentary narration with the drama of film storytelling.

Taksh’s voice carries a steady, grounded tone—ideal for factual documentaries, true events, and inspirational stories, while also bringing the cinematic flair needed for trailers, film-style intros, and YouTube storytelling. Whether it’s history, biography, or drama, Taksh’s delivery adds intensity, clarity, and emotional weight—perfect for platforms like YouTube, Spotify, OTT & TV.

voices.name: Sahir - Warm, Encouraging and Polished
voices.description:
A rich, gripping voice designed to build tension and deliver mystery with impact.

Sahir’s deep, deliberate tone pulls listeners into thrilling narratives—perfect for crime stories, dark podcasts, true crime documentaries, and YouTube series. Whether it’s for dramatic storytelling, horror intros, or psychological thrillers, Sahir brings a commanding intensity to suspense-driven content across Spotify, Audible, YouTube, and social media platforms.

voices.name: Vedant - Clear, Warm and Encouraging
voices.description:
A clear, authoritative, and empathetic voice designed for high-quality customer service.

Vedant A’s formal and polished tone is perfect for providing efficient and respectful customer support. Whether it’s answering inquiries, offering solutions, or guiding users through processes, his voice ensures each interaction is smooth and professional. Ideal for IVR systems, customer service chatbots, and virtual assistants.

voices.name: Daksh - Encouraging and Sarcastic
voices.description: A natural Hindi voice with a Delhi accent, perfect for conversational content. Ideal for relatable storytelling, podcasts, and casual narrations, it adds authenticity and connects effortlessly with Hindi-speaking audiences.

voices.name: Nikita - Encouraging, Clear and Serious
voices.description: Nikita is the pen name of a young Indian actress. Her lively and upbeat energy is clearly reflected in her tone, making it perfect for social media, narrations, and conversational bots. Give this voice a try, and you’ll fall in love with her energy.

voices.name: Ayesha - Confident and Encouraging
voices.description: Ayesha is the pen name of a very famous and talented voice over artist and singer. Her voice is well-suited for conversational-style ads, podcasts, narrations, e-learning, engaging content, etc. Do give it a try and you will love it.
